title: Anthropic Targets Valuation of Up to $1.4 Trillion for Blockbuster I.P.O.
summary: The A.I. company’s pricing would make it one of the biggest ever public listings. It comes at a volatile moment in markets, with investors questioning the sustainability of the A.I. boom.
